oneOf.description: An announcement channel: `@everyone` posts only in threads by default.
A 1:1 DM (no space, slug or name; always private).
A group DM of up to 9 people.

app_id.description: The Space's App; absent for the server-governed Space (governance `server`).

members.description: 0–100 distinct members (member ids or external ids) to add.

items.description: A member id (decimal string) or an external id (k2:principal:<uuid>, k2:workspace:<uuid>, k2:connect:<uuid>, k2:owner or local:<handle>).

name.description: The name, 1–100 characters. Used at create only.

private.description:
A private channel (its members are exactly the owner and `members`). Used at create
only.

slug.description: The slug, unique in the Space (the client rules). With `space_id`, the idempotency key.

space_id.description: The Space; it must be bound to an App, or be the server-governed Space.

type.description:
`text` (absent = text) or `voice`; `announcement` and the DM types are refused
(`400 validation_failed`, field `type`). Part of the idempotency check: an existing slug
of the other type is `409 conflict` `channel_type_mismatch`.
